text:
IncidentBot: ALERT — sustained prefix_cache hit-rate collapse detected for tenant HarborSec (vpc-eu-west-1, dedicated pool hs-prod). Severity: P1. Trigger: prefix_cache_hit_rate < 8% over 4m. Paging oncall.

Priya (oncall): Received. Taking incident lead. Paging Alex and Maria. @CSM - Jordan fyi — possible customer impact on generation latency.

Alex H: I'm seeing a correlated spike in token consumption and 5xxs. p50 from 70ms -> 380ms, p95 ~1.8s. 4xx are normal. Cache eviction counters jumping. Suspect cross-tenant prefix pollution.

Maria T: Can we get current prefix stats and inflight prefetch counts for hs-prod?

Alex H: Snippets:
```
[2026-03-15T03:05:12Z] prefix_cache: tenant=harborsec hit_rate=5.4% evictions=15890 reserved_slots=0
[2026-03-15T03:05:14Z] prefetcher: tenant=ml-ingest inflight_prefetch=1400 prefetch_rate=210/s
[2026-03-15T03:05:15Z] router: pool=hs-prod fallback=92 routing_ms=140
```

Sanjay P: Looks like ml-ingest (a noisy tenant) is saturating the shared prefix store. For dedicated pools we usually reserve slots per tenant; not seeing reservation for HarborSec. Quick mitigations: (1) temporarily set reservation & isolate HarborSec prefixes (2) flush HarborSec prefix namespace to remove pollution (3) throttle prefetch for ml-ingest.

Priya (oncall): Prioritize reservation/isolation first to minimize customer impact. Maria, do we have a safe command to set reservation on dedicated pools?

Maria T: Yes. Use ops CLI:
```
ri-admin cache set --tenant harborsec --pool hs-prod --isolate true
ri-admin cache set --tenant harborsec --pool hs-prod --reservation 0.12
```
These are low-risk and reversible.

Priya (oncall): Applying now.

-- 2140010125 --

eng-infra-bot: ACTION EXECUTED: ri-admin cache set --tenant harborsec --pool hs-prod --isolate true --reservation 0.12 (exec by Priya) [ok]

Alex H: Hit-rate recovered to ~46% within a minute as warmed entries returned. Still observing wrong-prefix hits from earlier pollution. Recommend flushing HarborSec prefixes aged <3h.

Maria T: Issuing flush
```
ri-admin cache flush --tenant harborsec --pool hs-prod --prefix "cust:harborsec:" --age 3h
```

Priya (oncall): Flushing now.

-- 2140010280 --

eng-infra-bot: ACTION EXECUTED: ri-admin cache flush --tenant harborsec --pool hs-prod --prefix "cust:harborsec:" --age 3h (exec by Priya) [ok]

Alex H: After flush hit-rate ~82%. p95 came down to ~420ms. Still intermittent drops during ml-ingest bursts.

Maria T: Next, throttle prefetch for ml-ingest on that pool. Options: reduce inflight limit or disable prefetch for that tenant.

Sanjay P: Proposed commands:
```
# set tenant prefetch inflight cap
ri-admin prefetch set --tenant ml-ingest --pool hs-prod --inflight-cap 200
# or disable entirely
ri-admin prefetch set --tenant ml-ingest --pool hs-prod --enabled false
```
I'll lean to cap first to be less disruptive.

Priya (oncall): Apply inflight cap=200, then monitor.

-- 2140010544 --

eng-infra-bot: ACTION EXECUTED: ri-admin prefetch set --tenant ml-ingest --pool hs-prod --inflight-cap 200 (exec by Priya) [ok]

Alex H: After capping inflight prefetch, prefix hit-rate stabilized >90%, error rate back to baseline. p50 ~85ms, p95 ~210ms. Cost metrics normalizing.

CSM - Jordan: Notified HarborSec support and engineering contacts: "We observed degraded generation performance from ~03:05-03:45 UTC due to cross-tenant prefix cache pollution in your dedicated pool. We've applied isolation, flushed polluted prefixes, and rate-limited a noisy tenant. We will provide RCA and log exports." They requested an affected request id list and cost delta.

Priya (oncall): Handing off to Maria for RCA and postmortem. My shift ends in 10m; will remain reachable for 10 more.

Maria T: Taking over. Follow-ups / action items:
- RCA: why did ml-ingest increase prefetch so rapidly? (deploy bug or workload change)
- Infra: add per-tenant prefetch guardrail + auto-isolation triggers when reservation pressure > threshold
- Runbook: add explicit dedicated-pool tenant isolation steps and ops CLI snippets
- Notify product about potential UI alert for reservation pressure

Sanjay P: Filed INFRA-3499: "prefetch guardrails and auto-isolate on reservation pressure" assigned to eng-infra. Also added short-term automation: auto-apply reservation 0.1 when tenant hit_rate<10% and eviction_rate>500/s for >3m.

Alex H: I'll extract logs for CSM: timestamps, request ids, sample traces and token counts. Estimate extra tokens served due to cache misses and prefetch churn — will attach CSV.

CSM - Jordan: HarborSec asked for ETA on RCA. We gave 72 hours for a draft and 5 business days for full RCA. They're satisfied with immediate mitigations.

Priya (oncall): Final snapshot before handoff:
```
start: 2026-03-15T03:05:00Z hit_rate=5.4% p50=70ms p95=1.8s errors=2.7%
isolation+reservation 03:08Z
flush 03:12Z
prefetch cap 03:25Z
end: 2026-03-15T04:00:00Z hit_rate=91.7% p50=85ms p95=210ms errors=0.1%
customer impact window ~40m
```

Maria T: Thanks team. I'll own the incident tracker updates and the RCA. Please attach the log export to the tracker. Great runbook execution. :thumbsup:

eng-infra-bot: Incident P1 -> mitigated. Monitoring until 2140013600. Please ensure postmortem created and include mitigation commands used.
